Stable aggregate clicks do not defeat that causal finding. Support extends to the predicted beginning of displacement, not internet-wide decay or platform motives.

No completed intervention has consequences meeting the early-resolution rule. Continued product releases cannot settle a forecast with no deadline; under the narrower compulsory-intervention reading, the antecedent is also unestablished.
